description: Card: the account's videos, audio, voices or characters, numbered; videos play in place, audio and voices have a play button. WHEN: they choose one by eye or want to hear voices. Say one line and stop; never list them. A pick arrives as their message (id; url for videos and audio); a later pick wins. No card (terminal): the `list_*` tool. Free.
name: show_library
title: Show the user's videos, audio, voices or characters as a picker
